propositions: The CLI write-command parsing currently uses a hand-rolled manual loop in claim.py and transition.py instead of stdlib argparse, making flags drift from documentation and --help output.
Bare --force flag must yield default reason '(no reason given)' while --force=<reason> yields an explicit reason; this sentinel semantics must be preserved during refactor.
--assignee flag absent must fall back to ticket.default_assignee while --assignee '' (empty string) must explicitly clear the assignee; this None-vs-empty-string distinction must be preserved.
ConcurrencyError must still exit with code 10 after refactoring to argparse.
The refactored code must respect module-size (≤800 LOC) and per-function complexity ratchets by extracting along existing call-graph seams.
